note: San Miguel County publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (Zoning_Map.pdf) on its document center; its ArcGIS assessor map is parcel-focused. The county's public parcel layer (FeatureServer/217) has ZoningCode and ZoningDesc fields but they are blank for all parcels (count of non-blank = 0), so it carries no zoning. City of Las Vegas and Pecos zoning maps were not found as queryable services; Las Vegas code says the official map is kept on file with the City Clerk.
